ns2:section.sectionText: Statistical Reasoning for Everyday Life This introductory course teaches students how to be intelligent consumers of statistical information they may encounter in the media or their future careers. Emphasis is on developing critical thinking skills and a foundational understanding of statistical concepts from surveys and scientific studies concerning our health, behavior, attitudes, and beliefs by discussing and analyzing "real world" examples drawn from a variety of disciplines as well as popular press. STATS 100 or equivalent required.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
